acceptanceCriteria: (a) refused-member opencode lines mark usage totals malformed/UNKNOWN, with a focused test.
(b) post-restart detached handoff retains reason CONTEXT, contextTokens, hardTokens per CAL-V0-345, or the gap is specified.
(c) behavior accepted in the spec or fixed with a test.
body: Found by lane V1-1549 review repair (PR beamfall/corvint#1016, head 3c4e2b6b0) on 2026-10-17. (a) An opencode line refused for a repeated or case-folded member is still skipped by the CAL-V0-157/077 usage totals without marking the session malformed (same blind spot as fixed CAL-V0-347, on the totals path). (b) After a restart, a detached deferral whose worker has left the ledger hands off without the CONTEXT detail (strict marker cannot carry it; handoff-deferred event does). (c) A crossing whose record write failed before a restart is reported only after the next fresh line (CAL-V0-348 behavior).
title: Context-threshold residuals: refused opencode lines skip usage totals; restart drops CONTEXT detail on detached handoff
